title: Book Two · Chapter 65: The Ear Above the Basket
story:
The next Thursday, Ronan brings the dog book back to school. He reads it once more before lessons. The little ear still shows above the basket in the first picture.

Mei sits nearby with her own book. Ronan turns his cover toward her.

“Do you want to find something?”

“What?”

“A kitten.”

Mei looks at the picture. Her finger goes straight to the ear.

“There.”

Ronan feels a little disappointed. Mum needed longer. He hoped Mei would need longer too.

“That was fast,” he says.

“I like cats.”

He wants to say he found it first. But he did not. He read the ending first. Only then did he find the ear. He leaves the book open.

“Read this part,” he says. “The woman cannot see it from the gate.”

Mei reads the lines. She asks why the dog stays beside the cart. Ronan tells her about the basket. Then he lets her turn the page.

At break, she finishes the story. She puts one hand under the cover. Then she gives the book back.

“Can I borrow it next?”

“You need to ask the helper.”

“I know.”

Ronan smiles a little. He carries the book to the return side of the desk. He leaves it there while the helper finds the card.

Another child comes behind him. Ronan moves aside. The helper checks his name and the date. Then she places the book on the checked side.

“Finished,” she says.

Ronan sees Mei in the short line for new books. She waits for her own turn. He leaves the dog book on the desk. The card is not ready for a new name yet.

Outside, Jun has a long twig. He draws a cart in the dust. Ronan adds a dog with four very straight legs.

“That dog cannot sit,” Jun says.

“It is working.”

Jun draws a small basket under the cart. Then he gives the basket two enormous ears.

“That kitten cannot fit,” Ronan says.

“It is growing.”

Leo comes over and makes a horse in front. The horse has legs like a table. They stand back to look at the whole picture.

Before they leave, a breeze moves dry leaves across the drawing. One leaf lands on the horse's head. Leo calls it a hat. Ronan finds another leaf and puts it on the dog. Jun puts the largest leaf on the basket. They leave the strange family there in the dust.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

ear＝耳朵；return＝归还；helper＝帮手。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样向Mei介绍狗的故事？
2. 他怎样完成归还？

## 读句子

**Mei / reads / the lines.** Mei／读／那些句子。
